We work with the $2\times2$ Nambu Green's function $\hat G$ and self-energy $\hat\Sigma$.
Resumming the Dyson series gives
\begin{equation}
\hat G(\omega) = \hat G_0(\omega)\left[1 - \hat\Sigma(\omega)\hat G_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} ,
\label{eq:d1}
\end{equation}
which we also write as
\begin{equation}
\hat G(\omega) = \left[1 - \hat\Sigma(\omega)\hat G_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} \hat G_0(\omega) .
\label{eq:d2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
